title: Travel Completed | ASL | Not Eligible | Extraordinary | Delay on Arrival | Single Pax | 1 Leg
description:
Israel-destination flight (YYZ?TLV) delayed 4 hours due to severe weather (Code 72). Under ASL, weather is classified as "extraordinary circumstances" � outside airline control. Despite a 4hr delay that would qualify if controllable, the extraordinary classification blocks eligibility. ASL counterpart to APPR TC_066 (NE-28, uncontrollable weather) and EU TC_140 (NE-23, extraordinary weather). Validates that extraordinary classification is consistent across all three regimes.

Prerequisites:
PNR: single passenger (Adult). Journey: 1 leg AC operated, Flight AC 084, YYZ?TLV. Scheduled arrival: 16:00. Actual arrival: 20:00 (4hr delay). Disruption code: 72 (Weather � Severe Thunderstorm). Arrival code: 72 (available, no fallback). ASL classification: Extraordinary Circumstances. APPR classification: Uncontrollable. Delay: 4hrs (would be eligible if controllable). Regime: ASL (TLV destination) + APPR (YYZ origin).
